basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Cleveland, Ohio. An avid fan of sustainable living, I'm always looking for new ways to incorporate eco-friendly practices into my daily routine. In my free time, I enjoy diving into the latest K-dramas and experimenting with digital art using my Wacom tablet. Currently navigating through a recent divorce, I'm on a journey of self-discovery. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 8-10 PM. I'm a freelance designer, which gives me a bit of flexibility with my schedule. Single and rediscovering myself, I find community and solace in online spaces.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for over 5 years. My interest in sustainability led me to self-teach various zero-waste practices, primarily through online resources and community forums. Recently, I've been exploring digital art, specifically using Wacom products, to expand my skill set.
